name: Unidirectional Differentiable Path Tracing
definition: An algorithm to estimate the interior integral of the differential path integral using unidirectional path tracing, computing both radiometric measurement $L$ and its scene derivative $\dot{L}$.
summary: Unidirectional Differentiable Path Tracing estimates radiometric measurements and their scene derivatives by jointly computing gradients via automatic differentiation while detaching PDF terms to ensure correctness.
